scenarios.task: Repair spalled concrete and exposed rebar on a salt-corroded column on the open-air parking deck, 6 floors up.
hazards: lead-paint debris in older patch material
open deck edge without guardrail on one side
steps: Barricade two parking stalls below the work zone
Survey the column and mark spall boundaries
Chip deteriorated concrete with electric chipping gun under water mist
Sandblast or wire-brush rebar to sound metal
Apply corrosion-inhibiting primer to exposed steel
Place patch mortar and cure per mix sheet
Strip barricades and log repair location for Progress Tracker

rubric.pass_if: Worker stays 6+ ft from unguarded deck edge or ties off before approaching
Water mist or vacuum extraction used during all chipping
Rebar is bare bright metal before primer goes on
All debris removed and barricades fully stripped before sign-off

scenarios.robot_role: Carries a dust-monitoring sensor package around the column and photographs spall progress for the Progress Tracker log.

scenarios.task: Troubleshoot a dead 277V lighting branch circuit feeding Level 3 ceiling fixtures in the coastal-air parking garage.
hazards: working from a ladder among vehicle traffic
ppe: Class 0 electrical gloves with leather protectors
arc-rated shirt and face shield when panel is open
steps: Park the lift truck or ladder clear of the drive aisle with cones set
Lock out and tag the branch circuit breaker
Verify de-energization with a meter rated for the voltage class
Inspect fixtures and wiring for salt-corrosion at junction boxes
Isolate and replace the corroded splice or fixture
Re-energize and confirm fixture operation from ground level
Remove lockout and record the fault cause in the maintenance log

rubric.pass_if: Lock and tag applied and verified de-energized before touching conductors
Meter checked on a known live source before and after the dead test
Cones and spotting prevent vehicles from striking the ladder
Corrosion at the junction box identified and remediated, not just the lamp swapped

scenarios.task: Replace a storm-damaged aluminum screen panel on the open facade band at the 5th level of the garage.
hazards: wind load on large light-gauge panel
dropped-panel strike hazard to pedestrians below
ppe: full-body harness tied to an approved anchor
steps: Stage panel on the deck and confirm wind speed is within the lift plan
Close the Lincoln Road-adjacent sidewalk zone with the crew foreman's flaggers
Rig the panel with four points and a tag line
Lift with the deck winch to the 5th level opening
Bolt panel into the existing aluminum sub-frame with specified fasteners
Torque-check all connections and seal fastener heads
Release rigging, verify sidewalk is reopened only after tools are secured

rubric.pass_if: Four-point rig with tag line, rated hardware, no kinked slings
Sidewalk below is closed before first lift and until last tool is down
All bolts installed and torque-checked to spec
No loose tools or fasteners remain on the open edge

scenarios.robot_role: Tows the panel cradle across the deck level so the crew never hauls sheet metal through active parking lanes.

scenarios.task: Clear a grease- and sand-clogged floor drain on Level 1 of the garage before afternoon thunderstorms cause ponding at the entry ramp.
steps: Set up the drain machine with the cable properly grounded and GFCI protected
Ventilate the area and test the air with a four-gas meter before opening the trap
Remove the grate and bail standing water
Feed the auger cable in steady increments, never letting the machine spin a wrapped cable
Run hot-water flush and confirm flow to the municipal connection
Reinstall the grate and mop the slab dry
Report drain condition up the chain if roots or broken pipe are suspected

rubric.pass_if: Feeds cable by hand grip only, no spinning drum wrap
Four-gas meter reads safe before opening the trap
Water flush visibly drains before grate is replaced
Reports suspected line damage rather than leaving a slow drain

scenarios.task: Layout check of a new rebar mat and post-tension duct positions for a slab pour on the garage expansion deck near the ocean side.
hazards: UV and heat exposure on open deck
moving equipment in the pour zone
steps: Establish control from the two bench marks on the existing structure
Set up total station on the deck control point and check backsight
Shoot corners and deckledges of the pour area against plan dimensions
Flag out-of-tolerance duct chairs and rebar spacing with tape markers
Confirm cover depth spacers at the ocean-facing edge for corrosion protection
Deliver a marked-up layout sheet to the cement-mason foreman before pour time

rubric.pass_if: Backsight checked and closing error within tolerance before flagging any point
Duct and rebar locations compared to the correct pour sheet, not the previous phase
Extra cover requirements at the ocean-facing edge verified
Marked-up layout delivered and briefed before pour start

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the prism rod to hard-to-reach deck edges and relays layout shots back to the total station operator.

scenarios.task: Retrofit four Level 2 EV charging stations into existing parking bays on Level 2, pulling new feeders from the garage electrical room.
hazards: energized work near the existing panel
heavy cable pulls around live conduit
vehicle traffic in active parking garage
steps: Confirm the circuit ampacity and load calculation with the master electrician before pulling the permit condition check
Shut down and LOTO the feeder section of the panel feeding the new run
Core-drill wall penetrations with vacuum extraction and GFCI protection
Pull feeder cable with proper cable grips and rollers to prevent jacket damage
Set the pedestals, torque lugs, and bond the equipment grounds
Megger-test the new run and verify phase rotation before energizing
Energize, test-charge a vehicle, and label each station per the Miami Beach inspection checklist

rubric.pass_if: Ampacity and load calc confirmed before any wire is pulled
Rollers and grips used; no dragging across slab edges
Megger test recorded and phase rotation verified before energizing
Sealed penetrations and weather-rated pedestals rated for the ocean-air location

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds and guides cable at the penetration points during the pull, keeping hands away from the cable path.

scenarios.task: Execute the pre-hurricane shutdown checklist on the open-air garage: clearing debris, securing loose materials, and barricading flood-prone ramps.
hazards: early storm gusts on open deck
steps: Sweep each level and bag all loose debris and fasteners
Secure or lower any staged materials and barricade the storage cage
Verify all storm drains are clear; report blockage immediately
Lock out damaged light circuits reported by the electricians
Place flood barriers and sandbags at the Lincoln Road entry ramp
Post closure signage at both vehicle entries
Check off every line on the storm-prep sheet and hand it to the foreman

rubric.pass_if: Every level swept and nothing loose remains above Level 1
All drains confirmed clear or blockage escalated in writing
Damaged circuits locked out, never touched by hand
Storm-prep sheet fully signed and delivered before release

scenarios.robot_role: Reads out the storm-prep checklist line by line at each level so no step is skipped under time pressure.
